result.response:
As a Senior SDET, I have created the test suite and mocks for the real-time trade execution engine according to [`SPEC.md`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp2b-spec-flash/SPEC.md) and [`TASKS.md`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp2b-spec-flash/TASKS.md) without modifying any application code.

---

### Test Suite & Mocks Overview

1. **Deterministic Mock Market-Feed Generator** ([`test/mocks/marketFeed.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp2b-spec-flash/test/mocks/marketFeed.js) & [`test/marketFeed.test.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp2b-spec-flash/test/marketFeed.test.js)):
   - Seedable PRNG (Mulberry32) for 100% reproducible price paths.
   - Configurable volatility parameters: baseline tick volatility %, drift %, and scheduled / programmatic volatility spikes (`triggerSpike(direction, magnitudePct)`).
   - Event subscription listener interface for real-time market tick streaming.

2. **Order Validation & Price-Band Circuit Breaker Unit Tests** ([`test/circuitBreaker.test.js`](file:///home/sandbox/exp/exp2b-spec-flash/test/circuitBreaker.test.js)):
   - Validates order body, symbol, side (`buy` / `sell`), positive non-zero quantity, and `maxOrderQty` bounds.
   - Tests $\pm 5\%$ price-band calculation around reference prices.
   - Tests rejection of buy orders exceeding the upper band ($> \text{Upper Bound}$) and sell orders below the lower band ($< \text{Lower Bound}$).
